theme: Units that win by not fighting fair
title: The Hill Isn't Worth Less Than the Kill
strategies: trivial: never move, never attack -- reproduces the evaluator's own calibrated 0.1 baseline exactly

greedy: the obvious first pass -- every turn, whichever enemy currently has the globally lowest HP, beeline to a reachable tile adjacent to it and attack, with zero regard for the tile stood on; maximizes immediate kills but abandons the two disclosed objective (hill) tiles the instant any enemy is reachable and never returns for them

strong: value every reachable tile by the defense bonus it grants you and denies the enemy for the turns that follow (terrain_defense*2, +5 on an objective tile) and only let an attack outrank good ground when it is pooled (per-turn focus-fire bookkeeping across already-processed squadmates) to finish a kill outright this turn; otherwise hold the best reachable tile and let the fixed, fully-disclosed enemy AI walk into an unfavorable fight

headroom above strong: model the enemy AI's own deterministic pathing/target-selection rule one turn ahead to pre-position a kill zone (a hill tile from which two units simultaneously finish two different incoming enemies before they can attack), instead of only reacting to who is already reachable this turn
